messages:
deploy-bot: [deploy] started rollout redwood-api v2.3.1 -> v2.4.0 (chart=redwood-api-chart@7.2.0) canary=10% at 1826237890

deploy-bot: preflight failed: values.yaml hash mismatch (detected values-drift). blocking canary.

--- diff snippet ---
- tls.cert: old
+ tls.cert: rotated by infra
--- end ---

sara: Hmm, that drift lines up with the KMS rotation at 03:02 UTC. Did someone rotate the values-secret? :eyes:

tom: That was me — I rotated the cert for staging->prod refresh. Thought it was outside the change window, but might've overlapped. sorry.

anne: We're in a restricted change window. deploy-bot can't decrypt canary secrets because KMS calls are being rate-limited (429). Canary pods fail to mount secret.

ops-oncall: Quick options: a) abort canary and rollback to chart 7.1.9 (pin) b) patch canary release to previous values-hash to pass preflight c) extend change window and let KMS backoff recover.

sara: Prefer not to roll code back. Can we trick preflight to re-run by annotating the canary release with previous hash, then re-run preflight? That way only the canary bypasses the drift check.

tom: I can push an annotation: helm.redwood.io/values-hash=abc123-prev to the canary deployment and call preflight. If KMS recovers pods should mount secrets fine.

deploy-bot: To annotate and re-run preflight, run:

```
kubectl annotate deployment/redwood-api-canary --overwrite helm.redwood.io/values-hash=abc123-prev -n prod
/opt/deploy/bin/deploy-bot preflight --thread 1826237890
```

anne: That will bypass the static hash check, but runtime secret access can still fail if KMS 429s persist. Logs show ~3.5K 429s starting 03:01 UTC.

ops-oncall: KMS rate limit looks transient; estimated recovery ~5min based on throttling window. My vote: wait 6 minutes, then try the annotate + preflight. If still failing, escalate to pin + abort canary.

tom: I'll revert the rotation (rollback the secret change) and attempt the annotate + preflight after 6m. If KMS still throttling, I'll switch to option (a) and pin chart to 7.1.9 and abort canary. I'll update thread in 5m.

sara: :thumbsup: Add a follow-up in release notes: "Secret rotation collided with change window causing canary block; infra to rate-limit rotations during live canaries."

deploy-bot: ack. re-run scheduled by tom at 1826238200. I'll post status update once preflight completes or times out.
